title: Imaging Features by Machine Learning for Quantification of Optic Disc Changes and Impact on Choroidal Thickness in Young Myopic Patients.
summary: 896 young myopic participants randomly divided 627 training/269 test; LASSO-derived fundus imaging features form optic-disc indicators, evaluated against choroidal thickness and ocular features. Retrospective internal holdout only.
ai_technology: ML-derived imaging measure is associated with quantitative ophthalmic phenotype; no external/clinical benefit claim.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: 896 young myopic participants randomly divided 627 training/269 test; LASSO-derived fundus imaging features form optic-disc indicators, evaluated against choroidal thickness and ocular features. Retrospective internal holdout only.
evidence.unknown: This is retrospective internal holdout evidence from 896 participants (627 training, 269 test); it does not establish external or prospective performance.
evidence.ai_role: ML-derived imaging measure is associated with quantitative ophthalmic phenotype; no external/clinical benefit claim.
